item.title: LSMSA’s Dr. Allison Landry receives University of Chicago Outstanding Educator Award (2026-10-28)
item.description: Dr. Allison Landry, Senior Lecturer of Biology at the Louisiana School for Math, Science, and the Arts (LSMSA), has received the University of Chicago (UChicago) Outstanding Educator Award.
